claims.claim: Escrow is exact by construction: escrow == totalUnits * pricePerUnit
A unit cannot be counted twice
A stranger cannot count units or stall before the deadline
A takeover requires a bond of at least 50% of the remaining escrow
When the taker also fails, the bond moves to the buyer and the remainder is refunded
Conservation: every wei is owed as a credit or locked in a live job
The contract has no owner, no pause, no admin path

evidence.note: no Ownable, no onlyOwner, no selfdestruct

not_claimed: that a counted receipt corresponds to good work
